title: MessageEntry named struct replaces opaque 4-tuple in TUI sort path
description: kith-tui/src/event.rs: replacing (String, String, String, String) with MessageEntry { received_at, display_line, msg_id, sender_id } is the correct abstraction level — the sort key (received_at) is now explicit, and the sort/filter/collect pipeline is readable without positional comments. A contributor might suggest reverting to a tuple for brevity, but the named fields prevent the class of bug where .0 and .1 are swapped silently.
